prompt:
主題：
夕空の白い光線

主体：
薄暮の田舎道で、巨大な円盤型飛行物体の白い光線を浴びる成人女性を後方から写す縦位置の幻想写真。 人物は画面中央を基準に配置する。

人物・表情：
腰までの淡い茶色のウェーブ髪と薄い前髪。細い卵形輪郭、横長の茶色い目、自然な眉、小ぶりな鼻、艶のある桃色の唇。片手を頭上へ添え、肩越しにカメラを見る。 顔を肩越しにカメラへ向ける。 落ち着いた表情。

服装・ポーズ：
白い細紐の三角ビキニトップ、白い短いレーススカート。背中を向けて道中央に立ち、上体をひねり、片腕を頭上へ曲げる。

背景・光：
住宅と電柱が並ぶ細い道、遠い山、青紫の夕空。画面上半分を巨大な金属円盤が覆い、中央から幅広い白い円錐光が人物と道路へ落ちる。 画面背景の主光は画面左からの柔らかな光。

構図・カメラ：
13:18の縦構図、カメラは低い後方斜めの膝上写真。人物を下中央、巨大円盤を上端いっぱい、白い光線で両者を結ぶ。振り向く顔と円盤の下面に焦点。 人物を大きく収め、主役へ焦点を合わせ、背景は軽いボケ。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな映画的幻想写真。金属円盤、白い体積光、夕空、レース、髪の逆光を現実的な質感で精細に描く。

ネガティブ：
上空の巨大円盤と人物へ落ちる円錐光を省かない

promptTranslations.en:
Subject:
White beam of light in an evening sky

Main subject:
A vertical fantasy photograph taken from behind of an adult woman bathed in a white beam of light from a giant disc-shaped flying object on a country road at dusk. The figure is positioned centered in the frame.

Person & Expression:
Waist-length light brown wavy hair and thin bangs. Slender oval face contour, horizontally wide brown eyes, natural eyebrows, petite nose, glossy pink lips. One hand resting atop her head, looking at the camera over her shoulder. Turning her face over her shoulder toward the camera. Calm expression.

Attire & Pose:
White thin-string triangle bikini top, short white lace skirt. Standing in the middle of the road with her back turned, twisting her upper body, bending one arm above her head.

Background & Lighting:
A narrow road lined with houses and utility poles, distant mountains, a blue-purple evening sky. A giant metallic disc covers the upper half of the frame, with a wide white conical beam of light projecting downward from its center onto the person and the road. The main background light is soft light coming from the left of the frame.

Composition & Camera:
13:18 vertical composition, camera at a low rear-diagonal angle capturing a knee-up shot. The person is positioned at the lower center, the giant disc completely filling the top edge, with the white beam of light connecting the two. Focus on the turning face and the underside of the disc. The subject is framed prominently in sharp focus, with a gentle bokeh in the background.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic cinematic fantasy photography. Depict realistic textures in fine detail for the metallic disc, white volumetric light, evening sky, lace, and backlit hair.

Negative:
Do not omit the giant disc in the sky and the conical light beam falling upon the person

summaryTranslations.en: Fantasy photography prompt depicting a woman in a bikini bathed in a beam of light from a giant unidentified flying object (UFO) on a rural road at dusk.

translations.zh:
主题：
傍晚天空的白色光束

主体：
黄昏乡村小路上，从后方拍摄沐浴在巨大飞碟白色光束中的成年女性的竖幅奇幻照片。人物置于画面中央。

人物与表情：
及腰浅棕色微卷发和轻薄刘海。鹅蛋脸、细长棕眼、自然眉毛、小巧鼻梁、粉嫩唇彩。单手扶头顶，回眸看向镜头。表情沉着。

服装与姿势：
白色细带三角比基尼上衣，白色超短蕾丝短裙。背对镜头立于道路中央，微侧上身，一臂举至头顶。

背景与光影：
排列着房屋与电线杆的小路，远山，蓝紫渐变晚霞。巨大金属飞碟遮挡上半画面，中心打下宽大锥形白光笼罩人物与路面。背景主光为左侧柔光。

构图与镜头：
13:18纵向构图，低机位后斜膝上景深。人物居中偏下，飞碟占顶端，白光相连。聚焦于回眸脸庞与飞碟底部，背景轻微虚化。

质感与风格：
写实电影感奇幻摄影。细致刻画金属飞碟、体积光、晚霞、蕾丝和逆光发丝。

负向提示：
不可遗漏上空的巨大飞碟和落向人物的圆锥光线
translations.en:
Subject:
White ray in evening sky

Main Subject:
Vertical fantasy photo taken from behind an adult woman bathed in a white beam from a massive saucer-shaped UFO on a rural road at twilight. Centered composition.

Person & Expression:
Waist-length light brown wavy hair, thin bangs. Oval face, brown eyes, natural brows, glossy pink lips. One hand on head, looking back over shoulder. Calm expression.

Clothing & Pose:
White thin-string triangle bikini top, white short lace skirt. Facing away in center of road, twisting torso, one arm bent above head.

Background & Light:
Narrow road with houses and utility poles, distant mountains, twilight sky. Massive metallic saucer covering upper part, wide white cone light beaming down. Soft key light from left.

Composition & Camera:
13:18 vertical framing, low rear-angle knee-up shot. Focus on turning face and underside of craft, slight background blur.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic cinematic fantasy photography. Detailed rendering of metallic saucer, volumetric light, evening sky, lace, and backlit hair.

Negative:
Do not omit the giant saucer and conical light beam
